subject: [hw] opus-dec2 -> kernel/ABI rev 3 for the NEXT image (not q10jx): exact decode needs from the binary (facts/VDEC_REGISTERS.md section 5)
body: Agrees with DEC07/DEC04 RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL = 12 (0x16000000 + 0x30000), per-page domain: 0x00000-0x1ffff VDE, 0x20000-0x2ffff VDE2 AND VDE, POLL re-checks power. Exact larb rule from the binary [V util 0x292e8/0x2935c]: the ONLY larb register the decoder touches is +0x00c (SMI SLP_CON): WRITE_MASK mask=1 (bit0 sleep request, set then cleared) and READ (polls bit16, 50000 tries). Core path -> larb4 0x1602e00c (smi_larb slot = 0x2e000 [V]); LAT path (core index 3/4) -> soc_smi_larblat = larb5 0x1600d00c (seen in opus-dec1 trace). Allow exactly that on both larb pages, refuse the rest. Clock gcon: vdec_hal_init_vdec_hw writes the CKEN SET registers VDEC_SYS 0x2f000+{0x000,0x008,0x018} and SOC_GCON 0x0f000+{0x000,0x008,0x018,0x0a0,0x0a8,0x0b0,0x200,0x218} [V offsets]; allow (enable-only), keep CLR offsets 0x004/0x00c refused until DEC02 shows them. Register access for H.264 decode is DIRECT MMIO (no GCE object is installed for H.264: vdec_set_vir_hw only in deinit) so every access is a RWVC_REGS op; frame = ~350-550 writes + 70-130 reads [I], far below RWVC_REG_MAX_OPS. No new ioctl. poll_timeout_us should allow >= 10 ms (start-code search on big slices). K02 power numbers: VDE 0x33c bit15 + VDE2 0x340 bit16 + larb4 needs MDP on: unchanged from kern/VCODEC_HW.md. VENC image q10jx: nothing changes.
